root_cause.text: The MPTCP retransmission path (`__mptcp_retrans`) holds `msk->fallback_lock` and, during reinjection after an MP_FAIL, calls into `__mptcp_try_fallback` which attempts to acquire the same lock, causing a recursive deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The lock trace in the CVE description shows that `__mptcp_retrans` already holds `&msk->fallback_lock` (lock #2) and then `__mptcp_try_fallback` (via `mptcp_sendmsg_frag`) tries to acquire it again. The patch avoids the deadlock by skipping reinjection when `msk->allow_subflows` is false, i.e., during an infinite fallback, preventing the recursive lock acquisition.
